# BPlan Festgestellt

LAYER
  NAME "bplanrastertindex"
  EXTENT 250063.8076 5227492.3957 961955.3570 6122928.5640
  STATUS OFF
  CONNECTION ""
  CONNECTIONTYPE POSTGIS
  PROCESSING "CLOSE_CONNECTION=DEFER"
  VALIDATION
    "planId" "^[0-9]*$"
    "default_planId" ""
    "xpversion" "^.*$"
    "default_xpversion" ""
    "planName" "^.*$"
    "default_planName" ""
    "ags" "^.*$"
